subject.title: Add structured process events for sessions

question: Should OpenClaw define a new core `process.*`/`step.*` session event contract, and what payload, replay, authorization, and redaction guarantees must it have?
rationale: The request would establish a new core event/API contract and expose intermediate run state; code inspection shows adjacent generic streams but no existing canonical process model to implement mechanically.

options.title: Design core process events first
options.body: Approve a small protocol design that defines event taxonomy, stable step identity, replay/ordering, persistence, and redaction before implementation.

options.title: Defer to existing streams
options.body: Close or narrow the request if maintainers want clients to compose existing agent/tool/task events instead of adding a process source of truth.

options.title: Track narrower surfaces separately
options.body: Split CLI stdout, Control UI Codex progress, and inter-session streaming into their existing narrower issues without a shared process contract yet.

recommendation.title: Design core process events first
recommendation.body: Approve a small protocol design that defines event taxonomy, stable step identity, replay/ordering, persistence, and redaction before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the clearest history on the closest existing structured activity/event work, making him the best available owner for the product-direction call.
